name: plank-with-feet-on-bench.html
instructions:
1. Place your feet on a bench and your forearms on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
2. Align your elbows under your shoulders and keep your hands flat or clasped.
3. Extend your legs fully, forming a straight line from head to heels.
4. Engage your core, glutes, and quads to keep your hips from sagging or lifting.
5. Keep your head in a neutral position, looking slightly forward or straight down.
6. Hold this position for the desired time, maintaining a tight, stable plank throughout.
starting_position: 1. Place your feet on a bench and your forearms on the floor, shoulder-width apart. 2. Align your elbows under your shoulders and keep your hands flat or clasped.
